speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the examination. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; to help me understand your condition, please tell me your gestational age and how many days old you are. Additionally, have you noticed any specific symptoms like grunting, nasal flaring, or retractions?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to prematurity. Given the history of gestational diabetes and cesarean delivery, please confirm if the baby is exhibiting grunting, nasal flaring, or chest retractions, and request a Chest_X-Ray to confirm the diagnosis.
